scope: Read-only actual linked Supabase function/schema metadata; no customer transaction reads or financial writes
findings: Canonical sale writer has no stored per-line original tax allocation or authoritative tax calculator
Proforma generic command accepts client tax totals; this is not a verified sale-time tax calculator
Canonical proforma save rejects nonzero tax; conversion preview rejects nonzero source tax
Missing original evidence cannot be inferred as zero tax

implementedSafeguard: SQL1917 captures immutable sale-time facts atomically and records NO_VERIFIED_PRODUCER. Configured private verified evidence adapter is required for CAPTURED; no default tax/rate, historical backfill or automatic activation.
remainingExternalInput: A verified business tax calculation authority/policy producing actual original per-line amounts at sale posting is required before enabling tax-backed refunds for new taxed sales. Synthetic quote fixtures do not certify this authority.
